top_signals.title: Fed Rate Hike in December Is Possible, Macquarie's Wizman Says
top_signals.summary: Thierry Wizman, global FX and rates strategist at Macquarie, discusses the outlook for the US economy, inflation and the possibility of a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike this year. "December doesn't look like the wrong time to do it," Wizman says. "You'll have a new Summary of Economic Projections, and the Fed likes to make bold moves, or changes of direction of policy, in accordance with the release of the dots and the SEP." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: H100 becomes Europe’s No. 2 Bitcoin treasury after 2,455 BTC deal
top_signals.summary: Sweden’s H100 more than tripled its Bitcoin holdings to 3,506 BTC after completing an acquisition involving 2,455 BTC.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin’s BIP-110 supporters split onto minority chain as main network pulls ahead
top_signals.summary: BIP-110 is a proposed one-year change that limits non-financial data on Bitcoin and has sparked a debate over how Bitcoin's block space should be used.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
